      "step": 1,
      "text": "In the same manner you can make tidbits of {{ing_01|sow’s belly}}."

      "text": "{{ing_02|Pork chops}} prepared in a manner to resemble wild boar are pickled in {{ing_03|oil}} and {{ing_04|broth}} and placed in {{ing_05|spices}}."

    },
